item.title: BOOMSTICK (for Arch Linux)
item.description: Reinstalling Linux on a headless PC or a Raspberry Pi with the official installer can be a tedious affair. I would much rather drive the installation of a new workstation or server from the comfort of my existing workstation, where my editor is already set up the way I like it, and where I can safely keep notes and configs about the process. But before the target machine will accept a remote login, there is a handful of chores that have to be done by hand, every single time:
